summary: NGINX functions as a web server, reverse proxy, mail proxy, and generic TCP/UDP proxy server. It routes incoming network traffic, serves static content, and delegates requests to backend applications.
goodFor: Deploying a reliable, high-performance edge proxy or web server in front of your self-hosted applications.
watchOut: Configuration is entirely text-file based and syntax errors will prevent the service from reloading properly.
deployNotes: You can deploy it using Docker or native deb packages, and it typically requires persistent storage for access and error logs.
